timing: retrospective specification of previously generated candidate

sourceFacts.fact: For a recessive disorder, an affected child inherits the disease-associated allele from both parents.
An Aa by Aa cross yields AA, Aa, Aa and aa possibilities.

invariants: Exactly 2x2 cells: AA,Aa,Aa,aa; AA not carrier, Aa carrier, aa affected.
Independent possible outcome per pregnancy, not guaranteed four-birth sequence.
expectedLabels: Each pregnancy is a new event
layoutSpecification: Very clear original hand-painted PUNNETT SQUARE. Title 'Two carriers: autosomal recessive inheritance'. Subheading 'Aa × Aa'. Central exactly2x2grid. Column gamete headers ABOVE are 'A' over leftcolumn and 'a' over rightcolumn. Row gamete headers LEFT are 'A' top and 'a' bottom. Upper-left cell 'AA' with text 'Not a carrier'; upper-right 'Aa' with 'Carrier'; lower-left 'Aa' with 'Carrier'; lower-right 'aa' with 'Affected'. Use ivory AAcell, teal carrier cells, ochre aacell; samelettercase precisely. Small legend 'a = recessive disease-associated allele'. Bottom 'Each pregnancy is a new event'. No four realistic babies, no claim that exactly four births have these outcomes, no extra squares or impossible genotype.
forbiddenAnatomy: No claimed anatomical reconstruction, diagnostic image, histology or literal neuroanatomical pathway
No organ cutaways or invented internal spatial relationships

validation.sourceFacts: Checked against listed primary clinical sources during original topic review
validation.pixelChecks: Visually inspected every cell against row/column gametes: AA, Aa, Aa, aa are correct; carrier/affected labels and colours agree. Each-pregnancy wording prevents treating four squares as a guaranteed birth sequence.
